content.short: Goldsky provides real-time blockchain data and subgraphs for apps without managing complex infrastructure.
content.description: Goldsky delivers real-time data streams for applications while removing the burden of managing blockchain and data streaming infrastructure. It can index a blockchain or subgraph, apply transformations to tailor the data to your requirements, and stream the results to a data warehouse, webhooks, or an API, all in real time. By handling indexing, data shaping, and delivery in a single end-to-end flow, Goldsky enables teams to build responsive applications that react to on-chain activity as it happens.
